newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-England A have Academy in trouble at 62 for three.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-England A have Academy in trouble at 62 for three.

text.p: England A dominated the first day of their four-day match against the Australian Cricket Academy on Friday, taking three wickets in the first session of play.
The Academy XI were 62 for three at lunch after England A won the toss and asked their opponents to bat.
Opener Jerry Cassell was caught and bowled by Andrew Harris for two in the fourth over.
Spinners Peter Such and Mark Butcher then took a wicket each, Such having Lee Carseldine caught at cover and Butcher removing Justin Poole for the Academy to be 34 for three.
Opener Michael Dighton was on 23 and Shawn Craig 19.
